messages.subject: State-space model and DIC
parts:
Dear All,

I am trying to perform a space-state model in the context of a multivariate dynamic model.

I am using an augmented model, but I have two questions/problems:

 1-I have a fixed effect corresponding to a family effect, it is a factor. In my augmented model
 it corresponds to this vector:  ‘family <- as.factor(c(data$Family, rep(NA,T*I)))’ and I use the 
INLA option  ‘control.fixed = list(expand.factor.strategy='inla')’. So at the end I have the 
estimation of fixed effect for each family with a very high confidence interval (for example a
 mean at -0.83388673 with a sd at 8.1692117020). So it seems that because ‘NA’ values
correspond to ‘faked values’ the estimations of fixed effects are not right…
 
 2-My second question concerns DIC associated to an augmented model, how to ‘remove’
 the ‘faked’ values for computing the associated DIC given that the number of effective 
parameters seems to use all of observations.
 
Thanks for your help, 
Paul.

Hi, you may have induced a singularity if you haven't removed the intercept.

2-My second question concerns DIC associated to an augmented model, how to ‘remove’
 the ‘faked’ values for computing the associated DIC given that the number of effective 
parameters seems to use all of observations.
You can sum the desired local DIC values, that is sum(...$dic$local.dic) Elias

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] State-space model and DIC
parts:
On 28/11/2016 18:45, paul seron wrote:
> I mean \lambda =\sum_{p=1}^P X\beta_p for investigating effects of covariates on this part of the model.

Assuming that
\lambda = X\beta (matrix form)
you them have actually several \lambda's (one for each combination of
X\beta). You can write a model for a faked zero observations
0 = X\beta - z
where z will be copied in
$Y_{jt} = \dots +\lambda \sum_{j'\sim j} w_{j'j}
I_{j'(t-1)}$ +\dots$
with weights as \sum_{j'\sim j} w_{j'j} I_{j'(t-1)}. By weights I mean
the second argument for the f() term in the formula corresponding to the
copy.

Elias
